data.one_liner: A simple routing component for Jaspr web applications adapted from go_router.
data.what_it_does: Provides a declarative routing component for Jaspr web applications. It supports paths, lazy routes, code splitting, redirects, and browser history management.
use_when: You are building a web application using the Jaspr framework and need page routing.
You want support for lazy loading routes and code splitting via deferred imports in Jaspr.
You are already familiar with the go_router package concepts.
avoid_when: You are building a standard Flutter application (use go_router instead).
You do not use the Jaspr framework.
strengths: Supports lazy routes and automatic code splitting via deferred imports.
Handles server-side rendering redirects and base href configuration.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the Jaspr framework and cannot be used in normal Flutter apps.
Limited documentation outside of basic routing and lazy routes.
data.setup_notes: Add jaspr_router to pubspec.yaml and define routes in your component build method.
